title: Make Worker handoff unavailable-evidence assertions discriminating
outcome: Worker evidence tests fail if either explicit unavailable entry is removed, retain a transcript-command positive control, and do not claim host-verification coverage from a nonexistent JSON field.
acceptance: Missing-report regressions assert separate exact Notes prefixes for Git handoff and child-reported native test outcome, and assert the successful commandsRun transcript entry separately.
Vacuous verification-field assertions are removed or replaced by checks at a real host-verification boundary; failed/canceled evidence assertions state the actual command-omission contract.
